insights.one_liner: Switzerland's main telecom company, which runs a DevOps centre in Rotterdam offering English-language software internships.

culture.text: Besides Switzerland, it runs DevOps centres in Riga and Rotterdam that work on tech projects for the group.
Most staff are in engineering and IT and studied computer science or informatics, largely at Swiss universities.
Current openings are two software engineering internships in Rotterdam.

open.text: Both current Rotterdam internships are open to non-Dutch speakers.
It is not listed as an IND recognised sponsor.

growth.text: The Swiss telecom group has about 21,125 employees, and the Swiss state is listed as an owner.

worth_knowing.text: Its LinkedIn postings get about 43 applicants on average, fewer than many big brands.
